lina (Design): quick review: trace flyout micro-interactions. small list of fixes.
sam (Eng Runtime): go ahead
lina (Design): 1) copy icon too small and only hoverable. 2) no announcement after copy. 3) truncated symbols show tooltip only on hover, not keyboard. 4) export menu only JSON, customers asked for CSV with minimal columns.
maya (A11y): agree. aria-live for copies, buttons not spans, hit targets >=32px. tooltips need aria-describedby.
jo (SRE): add a "copy with trace id" action; engineers always paste both. Shift+click or a three-dot option on mobile.
sam (Eng Runtime): implementation: convert icons to buttons, add aria-labels, aria-live region; Shift+click doable. CSV needs backend flatten endpoint, will plan next sprint.
lina (Design): microcopy: toast should say "Copied to clipboard: <fn>" and SR should get function + file:line. CSV modal must warn about PII.
jo (SRE): default CSV must scrub sensitive fields and require explicit opt-in to include them.
deploy-bot: perf-check scheduled for streaming copy prototype on 2026-04-05 04:00 UTC
sam (Eng Runtime): i'll PR the hit-area + aria-live this sprint. tags: @maya for review.
lina (Design): thanks — i'll update the figma and add a short accessibility checklist.
